task: prompt Claude to propose skill updates
definition: Ask Claude to open a pull request improving its own skills from what it learned in channels.
outcome: Claude has opened a pull request against the skills repository proposing changes, which a person still has to review and merge

records.outcome: Claude opens a pull request against the skills repository proposing a skill change, which a human still reviews and merges before it reaches channels
preconditions: the skills repository is set up and Claude has write access to it
steps: In the channel, mention @Claude and ask it to open a PR to the skills repo so the skill includes what it just learned
Or ask @Claude to set a recurring routine that reviews the channel's corrections and opens one PR with the fixes
Review, edit, or close the pull request like any contributor's
Merge the PR so the updated plugin syncs to the organization

evidence.quote: Claude won't open skill PRs unprompted. Ask in the channel when something it learned should stick:

records.notes: The review/merge/propagate steps are stated in the 'How updates propagate' table, which is otherwise a concept table.
